title: New Limits on Chinese Drones Leave Police Facing Higher Costs
summary:
Police departments across the United States use drones, which are small flying machines with cameras, for many jobs. They help with search and rescue, fire and traffic crash investigations, and watching over big crowds. About 6,000 law enforcement agencies now have drones, according to the Law Enforcement Drone Association, a group that trains police to use them.

Most of those drones come from DJI, a company in China. The association estimates that about 80% to 90% of police drone programs use DJI devices.

The Trump administration wants to change that and help American drone makers. It has banned many new foreign-made drones from the U.S. market and announced tariffs, or extra taxes, of 15% to 100% on some foreign drones. The administration says Chinese drones could be a national security threat. DJI denies that its products share data with the Chinese government.

Many police leaders worry about the cost. In Ocean County, New Jersey, the sheriff's office has a fleet of 25 DJI drones. In July, it used a drone to drop flotation devices to two swimmers in trouble, and rescuers brought them to shore. Kevin Fennessy, who leads the program, says American drones are good but cost about three times as much.

NPR compared two similar drones. A Chinese DJI model sells for about $10,500, while an American-made one costs about $21,000.

Some states, including Florida and Texas, have banned police from using foreign drones, and some departments had to end their drone programs. A national sheriffs' group has asked federal regulators to allow an exception until American companies can make enough drones.

An American drone company leader says this is a chance to build more drones in the U.S. Fennessy says that if police must switch, "the funding's got to be there."
why_it_matters: Drones help police find missing people and save swimmers, so rules about them affect public safety. The debate shows how national security concerns and local budgets can pull in different directions.

background_read: Drones are flying machines with cameras that police use to search for missing people, study crash scenes and help with rescues.
A Chinese company, DJI, makes most of the drones used by American police because they are capable and cost less.
The U.S. government worries that technology made in China could create security risks, so it is limiting some foreign drones to boost American makers.
Police departments pay for equipment from limited budgets, so higher prices can make it harder for them to keep their drone programs.
